translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Siem ne joma oketo genogi kuom Misri

content.text: Mano kaka unune malit,
jogo madhi dwaro kony Misri,
moketo genogi kuom farese,
kendo moketo genogi kuom geche mag lweny mangʼeny magiywayo,
kendo kuom teko maduongʼ ma joidh faresegi nigo,
to ok uketo genou kuom Jal Maler mar Israel,
kata dwaro kony kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
Kata kamano en bende en gi rieko
kendo onyalo kelo chandruok;
bende ok olok pache e gima osewacho.
Obiro kumo joma timbegi mono,
kaachiel gi joricho makonyogi.
To jo-Misri gin mana dhano ma ok Nyasaye;
bende faresegi gin mana ringʼo ma ok roho.
Ka Jehova Nyasaye norie bade mar kum,
jogo machiwo kony nochwanyre,
kendo jogo mikonyo nopodh piny;
giduto ginilal nono.

content: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wachona:

content.text: Mana kaka sibuor ngʼur konyono chiayo mosemako piny,
kendo kata obedo ni jokwath duto oyworo ka goyo koko,
to ok odew bende ok oluor,
e kaka Jehova Nyasaye Maratego,
biro biro mondo oked ewi got Sayun.
Mana kaka winy mafuyo malo,
e kaka Jehova Nyasaye Maratego nochiel Jerusalem;
nogengʼe kendo norese, noume kendo nokonye.
mosengʼanyo mabor kode.
Nimar e odiechiengno ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu nowiti
nyiseche mag fedha kod dhahabu,
ma lwetu motimo richo oseloso.
Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya,
“Jo-Asuria ibiro tieki gi ligangla ma ok oa e lwet dhano;
nimar ligangla ma ok oa e lwedo biro tiekogi.
Giniring lweny nikech ligangla, mi yawuotgi ma
jolweny nolokgi wasumbini maketgi e tij achuna.
Kuondegi mochiel motegno nopodhi mi gidhier nono,
kendo jotendgi mag lweny,
kibaji nogo ma ok ginyal ringo,” Jehova Nyasaye wacho,
en ma maye liel koa Sayun,
kendo maye mangʼangʼni ni Jerusalem.
